parsed.basis: No particular rule or source. It was just common sense and courtesy: she had a cane and a large suitcase, so giving her extra room made sense, and in Singapore people generally keep left, but I moved right because that put more distance between us given where she was.
parsed.applies_to: Both decisions: shifting right and keeping well right to let the woman with the cane and suitcase pass
parsed.side_detail: The wall on my right was closer (0.57 m) than the wall on my left (1.18 m), but she was the one with the suitcase and cane, so moving toward my right kept me out of the wider space she needed and left her the clearer line to pass. Either side would have worked, but this gave her more room where she was.
